# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- diagnostic
def build_diagnostic(B=0):
    """Per cell, the analyst's headroom diagnostic computed in every replicate from the cross-fitted residual
    variances of the pooled linear and spline estimators (vh):
      sigma2_hat  = vh_spline / (1 + d_spl / n_train)           (inverts E vh_spline = sigma2 (1 + d/n_train))
      delta_hat   = vh_linear / (1 + d_lin / n_train) - sigma2_hat
      learning_cost = d_spl sigma2_hat / n_train
      headroom_hat  = delta_hat - learning_cost.
    pred_gain converts headroom_hat to a relative width gain: 1 - sqrt(1 - (1/n - 1/M) headroom_hat / se2_ppipp)."""
    rows = []
    for d, p in cell_paths():
        if d not in ("exp1", "exp3", "exp3b"):
            continue
        arms, meta = load_cell(p)
        if "pool_spline" not in arms or "pool_linear" not in arms:
            continue
        n, N, R = meta["n"], meta["N"], meta["R"]
        M = n + N
        nt = (K_CF - 1) * n / K_CF
        vl, vs_ = arms["pool_linear"]["vh"], arms["pool_spline"]["vh"]
        s2 = vs_ / (1 + D_SPL / nt)
        dl = vl / (1 + D_LIN / nt) - s2
        cost = D_SPL * s2 / nt
        hh = dl - cost
        se2 = arms["ppi++"]["se"] ** 2
        pg = 1 - np.sqrt(np.clip(1 - (1 / n - 1 / M) * hh / se2, 1e-9, None))
        w, wr = 2 * Z * arms["pool_spline"]["se"], 2 * Z * arms["ppi++"]["se"]
        ok = np.isfinite(w) & np.isfinite(wr) & (w > 0) & (wr > 0)
        rg = 1 - w[ok].mean() / wr[ok].mean()
        rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
        bi = rng.integers(0, ok.sum(), size=(300, ok.sum()))
        gb = 1 - w[ok][bi].mean(1) / wr[ok][bi].mean(1)
        pop = meta["pop"]
        fk = floor_key(pop)
        rows.append(dict(dataset=dataset_name(pop), group=group_of(meta["id"], pop, d), n=n, N=N, calibrator="calib_spline",
                         reps=R, delta_hat=dl.mean(), delta_hat_lo=np.quantile(dl, .025), delta_hat_hi=np.quantile(dl, .975),
                         learning_cost=cost.mean(),
                         headroom_hat=hh.mean(), headroom_hat_lo=np.quantile(hh, .025), headroom_hat_hi=np.quantile(hh, .975),
                         frac_positive=float((hh > 0).mean()), pred_gain=float(pg.mean()),
                         realised_gain=rg, gain_lo=float(np.quantile(gb, .025)), gain_hi=float(np.quantile(gb, .975)),
                         delta_pop=FLOORS[fk]["T1"]["Delta"] if fk else np.nan,
                         sigma2_res_pop=FLOORS[fk]["T1"]["sigma2_res"] if fk else np.nan))

    df.to_csv(os.path.join(R_DIR, "diagnostic.csv"), index=False)
    return df

def run_grid(exp, cells, procs, seed0=20261126, only=None):
    """cells: list of dict(id, pop, n, N, R, cfg). Each finished cell is written to
    results/<exp>/<id>.npz; existing cells are skipped (resumable)."""
    d = os.path.join(RESULTS, exp)
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    for i, c in enumerate(cells):
        path = os.path.join(d, c["id"] + ".npz")
        if os.path.exists(path):
            continue

        meta["id"] = c["id"]
        save_cell(path, arms, meta)
        print(f"[{exp}] {i+1}/{len(cells)} {c['id']} R={c['R']} {meta['seconds']:.0f}s", flush=True)
